raw_segments.text: Then Nestor Knight of Jaren answered, It is indeed as you say, it is all coming true
at this moment, and even Jove who thunders from on high cannot prevent it.
Fallen is the wall on which we relied as an impregnable bulwark both for us and our fleet.
The Trojans are fighting stubbornly and without ceasing at the ships.
Look where you may you cannot see from what quarter the rout of the Achaeans is coming.
They are being killed in a confused mass and the battle cry ascends to heaven.
Let us think, if counsel can be of any use, what we had better do.
But I do not advise our going into battle ourselves, for a man cannot fight when he is wounded.
